summary: Rank One Computing filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing entry on September 14, 2026 into a Contract for Commercial Products and Commercial Services with the U.S. Department of Justice Executive Office for United States Attorneys. The one-year base period runs September 22, 2026 to September 21, 2027, paying $7,414,143.80, covering DERP development on time-and-materials and ROC Evidence licenses on firm-fixed pricing. Seven one-year options could bring the aggregate to $64,301,418.24 over eight years. No board recommendation, advisor, or securities transaction is stated.
